script_text:
Stop! Pisces, the cosmos just threw a lightning bolt at your 10th House of Career, and it's not subtle.

Mercury is forming a challenging square to Neptune — your ruling planet — while the Sun opposes your sign in your 4th House of Home. This creates fog around your professional ambitions, making it nearly impossible to see which path serves your soul.

In love, if you're single, Venus in Libra aligns with your 5th House of Romance, drawing someone artistic toward you tonight. If taken, watch for miscommunication — Mercury's square to Neptune creates illusions that could distort your partner's intentions.

Career-wise, this square demands you rethink your 2nd House of Income. A financial opportunity appearing midweek feels too good to be true — wait for clarity before committing.

Avoid signing contracts today. The blessing coming instead is a surprise phone call from an old friend that restores your faith.
